instruction: Candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. In the center, the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands behind the bearded man in a dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1), hugging him tightly from behind with her arms wrapped around his chest and her head resting against his back. The man stands in profile facing right, calmly receiving the embrace. The background features white walls, mounted cameras, and office equipment. Bright, even overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R2 hugs R1 from behind rather than R1 hugging R2 from behind
R2 wraps her arms around R1's chest rather than R1 wrapping his arms around R2's chest
R1 calmly receives the embrace while R2 performs the behind-the-back embrace
R2 rests her head against R1's back
R1 stands in profile facing right while being embraced by R2
